description: XR Developers, Game Devs, Space Tech explorers
summary: Project XploreTUNE transforms NASA Earth Information Center (EIC) and Scientific Visualization Studio (SVS) imagery into an interactive 3D audio-visual instrument. Inspired by NASA’s Caldwell 73 sonification framework, an optical meridian scans a photorealistic 3D globe—featuring Blue Marble terrain, a day-night terminator, city lights, volumetric clouds, atmospheric rivers, and ISS lightning—converting pixel luminosity, color, and edges into real-time Web Audio music. Explore nine NASA datasets or upload custom SVS images and videos, sculpt sound with live octave and pitch tuning, ADSR envelopes, wavetables, resonant filters, and multi-layer mixers, or locate planetary anomalies in an accessible 3D Resonance Hunt mode.
